name: Realism Pass (Windows only, RTX only)
description: DLSS 5 Neural Rendering on your own ComfyUI: generated skin, hair and fabric look less waxy. With this recipe, Generate runs it on the selection's box: the box goes out at its own size, without a fill or the reference layers, and comes back as a layer over it. Over the whole picture it runs from Upscale › Realism Pass (Windows only, RTX only), which adds a new layer above the picture. Needs a ComfyUI on Windows with an RTX 30, 40 or 50 card and the community node pack ComfyUI-DLSS5-Enhancer with its runtime, which you install there yourself (Help › Scumble help › Realism Pass (Windows only, RTX only)); Scumble ships none of it. Preset L or M picks the DLSS model of the box; Style and Strength, for both: the Realism Pass row of the Upscale dialog.
